messages:
sam: Heads up — HW partner asked for a joint perf/W + throughput benchmark spec for their on‑prem SKU. We need a telemetry schema, metric calc, and a minimal SLA for marketplace onboarding. Goal: spec draft by EOD Wed. Thoughts?

jing: Can we reuse the infra bench schema and extend it? we should add per-kernel tags + power rail metadata. :thinking_face:

alex: Agree. Minimal required fields I think: model, sequence_len, batch_size, tokens_per_sec, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, avg_power_w, gpu_temp_c, kernel_variant, quantization, cpu_freq_mhz, run_id, git_rev, ci_tag. Keep names simple.

marie: Add power_sample_window_ms and power_sampling_rate_hz — partner streams board power at 100Hz so we need to record sampling params.

nathan: Also include prefill_tokens and kv_cache_hits to account for prefix/cache effects on throughput. We should provide a small example YAML for how runs are organized.

sam: Good call. Who will own upload + schema validation for partner uploads? @jing?

jing: I can own validation + CI checks. Need partner to write to s3://redwood-partner-bench/<partner>/<yyyy-mm-dd>/run.json.gz and include a top-level manifest.json with run_ids. Validator will check required fields, types, and presence of kernel_variant.

alex: On metric calc: perf_per_watt = tokens_per_sec / avg_power_w. We'll include the formula and clarify warmup removal (default warmup_tokens=128). Also capture standard deviation on power.

marie: We should also require kernel_variant to include a patch git hash and a flag 'vanilla' boolean so we can group patched vs stock kernels.

nathan: Timeline note: partner expects marketplace listing next month. We'll need a signed MOU + data sharing consent before publishing numbers. Legal will need to review.

sam: I'll loop in legal. @marie can you draft a 1‑page MOU template we can share as part of onboarding?

marie: On it. Draft by tomorrow morning and will attach the telemetry spec as an appendix.

jing: Implementation detail — telemetry payload should be newline-delimited JSON (ndjson), gzip compressed. Each sample point contains timestamp_ms, instantaneous_power_w, tokens_generated (delta), token_offset, and meta header lines with run-level keys. We'll add a validator in infra/bench/telemetry_validator and a human-readable spec at infra/bench/telemetry_spec.md in the repo.

sam: Can we run a small pilot this week? target: 10 runs, 3 kernel variants, 2 model sizes (small/medium). Partner ok with open models?

alex: Partner prefers our curated open models. I'll coordinate exact model list (Mistral-7B, Llama2-13B-ish candidates). Aim for pilot Friday. @benchbot please schedule a reminder sync Fri 9am PT.

benchbot: Reminder scheduled: Pilot bench sync Friday 2024-04-12 09:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to participants. :bell:

sam: Thanks all — I'll send a short spec draft to partner and cc this thread, include the s3 path + validator link. :thumbsup:
